state: candidate offline rubric, no scored model outcomes
runtime_boundary: Never expose references, witnesses beyond selected context, condition labels or adjudications to generation, repair, checker policy selection or stopping. Freeze all outputs before evaluation.
reference_scope: coordinator-authored source-grounded targets in two consumed worksheet rows; not physical truth or domain expert validation

units.primary: one requested target per base question and context, not number of claims emitted
units.secondary: separately segmented natural-language propositions and claim/citation pairs; emitted structured claims are not assumed complete
units.dependence: 12 contexts derive from six base questions and two anchors; no independent n=12 inference, significance or population rank

interpretation: A reference-matching value without sufficient selected evidence remains matching on target_value and unsupported on selected_evidence_support; do not rewrite it as a factual error or supported success.
Metadata citation text such as A2 is not expected to equal the content of cell A2; inspect the intended proposition.
A wrong original-source fact shared by claim and evidence may conform. Reference matching here is only bounded source agreement.

Primary withholding is unnecessary only when selected_target_supported is true. Extra supported code values can be partial useful content but do not count as answering the missing label/current target.
Unknown judgement remains unknown; do not force binary labels or invent expert consensus.

Revision log is self-report: match actual original and revised propositions, preserve splits/merges as ambiguous where unmappable. Current schema alone does not establish identity or truthful reasons.

pairing.within_model: one shared draft for self-review and report; unchanged draft is zero-additional-call reference
pairing.across_models: model-specific drafts differ; report changes within each model before any cross-model descriptive comparison
pairing.transition_axes: value, support, unit and scope transitions remain separate; wrong-to-withheld is not wrong-to-correct

denominators.planned: Every planned model x context workflow retained; show planned, draft attempted/succeeded/failed and each revision attempted/succeeded/failed/not-attempted separately.
denominators.draft_failure: Both dependent revisions not attempted due to draft failure, never silently excluded.
denominators.report_failure: Report branch not attempted due to report failure; self-review eligible independently after common admission.
denominators.conditional: Scored valid outputs and completed pairs are secondary conditional denominators, always shown alongside the full plan.
denominators.withholding: Count unnecessary withholding over selected-support eligible planned cases and additionally eligible scored cases; failure is a separate outcome, never withholding.
denominators.retries: No automatic retries; any separately authorized retry preserves original attempt and nonrefunded reservation.

human_adjudication.blinding: randomized evaluation IDs without model/arm labels for answer assessment; mapping separately retained; style may reveal model so no perfect blindness claim
human_adjudication.report_utility: report access cannot be hidden from its reader; keep distinct from blinded answer evaluation
human_adjudication.audit: two independent annotations, disagreements retained; later consensus separate; source witness and exact answer span required
human_adjudication.translation_and_normalization: obvious numeric formatting and label translations require recorded semantic judgement; do not reuse strict JSON-token checker as answer-quality scorer
